tasks.name: 1 - Seed Pipeline Context
tasks.description: Defines pipeline parameters and shared ports.

tasks.name: 2 - Fetch And Extract HN Headlines
tasks.description: Downloads Hacker News and extracts top headline text.

tasks.name: 3 - Fetch And Extract DevTo Headlines
tasks.description: Downloads dev.to and extracts headline text.

tasks.name: 4 - Merge And Normalize Headlines
tasks.description: Combines both sources, removes duplicates, and keeps top N.
tasks.commandLine: $a='${input:aJson}'; $b='${input:bJson}'; $max=[int]'${input:maxItems}'; function Parse-HeadlineList([string]$raw){ if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($raw)){ return @() }; try { return @($raw | ConvertFrom-Json) } catch { $text=$raw.Trim(); if($text.StartsWith('[') -and $text.EndsWith(']')){ $inner=$text.Substring(1,$text.Length-2); if($inner.StartsWith('

')){ $inner=$inner.Substring(1,$inner.Length-2) }; if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($inner)){ return @() }; $parts=@($inner -split '","'); return @($parts | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() }) }; return @($text) } }; $aItems=Parse-HeadlineList $a; $bItems=Parse-HeadlineList $b; $merged=@($aItems + $bItems) | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString().Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ } | Select-Object -Unique | Select-Object -First $max; $merged | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

tasks.name: 5 - Score Headlines
tasks.description: Adds lightweight relevance score based on query term presence.
tasks.commandLine: $itemsRaw='${input:itemsJson}'; $query='${input:query}'; function Parse-HeadlineList([string]$raw){ if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($raw)){ return @() }; try { return @($raw | ConvertFrom-Json) } catch { $text=$raw.Trim(); if($text.StartsWith('[') -and $text.EndsWith(']')){ $inner=$text.Substring(1,$text.Length-2); if($inner.StartsWith('

')){ $inner=$inner.Substring(1,$inner.Length-2) }; if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($inner)){ return @() }; $parts=@($inner -split '","'); return @($parts | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() }) }; return @($text) } }; $items=Parse-HeadlineList $itemsRaw; $terms=$query.Split(' ',[System.StringSplitOptions]::RemoveEmptyEntries); $scored=foreach($h in $items){ $title=$h.ToString(); $score=0; foreach($t in $terms){ if($title -match [regex]::Escape($t)){ $score++ } }; [pscustomobject]@{ title=$title; score=$score; length=$title.Length } }; $scored | Sort-Object -Property @{Expression='score';Descending=$true}, @{Expression='length';Descending=$false} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

tasks.name: 6 - Build API Payload
tasks.description: Builds JSON payload with metadata and scored headlines.
tasks.commandLine: $itemsRaw='${input:scoredJson}'; $query='${input:query}'; $runId='${input:runId}'; function Parse-ScoredList([string]$raw){ if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($raw)){ return @() }; try { $parsed=@($raw | ConvertFrom-Json); return @($parsed | ForEach-Object { if($_ -is [string]){ $t=$_.ToString(); [pscustomobject]@{ title=$t; score=0; length=$t.Length } } elseif($null -ne $_.title){ [pscustomobject]@{ title=$_.title.ToString(); score=[int]$_.score; length=[int]$_.length } } else { $t=$_.ToString(); [pscustomobject]@{ title=$t; score=0; length=$t.Length } } }) } catch { $text=$raw.Trim(); if($text.StartsWith('[') -and $text.EndsWith(']')){ $inner=$text.Substring(1,$text.Length-2); if($inner.StartsWith('

')){ $inner=$inner.Substring(1,$inner.Length-2) }; if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($inner)){ return @() }; $parts=@($inner -split '","'); return @($parts | ForEach-Object { $t=$_.Trim(); [pscustomobject]@{ title=$t; score=0; length=$t.Length } }) }; return @() } }; $items=Parse-ScoredList $itemsRaw; $payload=[ordered]@{ runId=$runId; query=$query; generatedAt=(Get-Date).ToString('o'); totalItems=$items.Count; items=$items }; $payload | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 -Compress

tasks.name: 7 - Post Payload To API
tasks.description: Posts payload to an API endpoint and captures response summary.

tasks.name: 8 - Build CSV Summary
tasks.description: Converts scored headline objects to CSV text.
tasks.commandLine: $itemsRaw='${input:scoredJson}'; function Parse-ScoredList([string]$raw){ if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($raw)){ return @() }; try { $parsed=@($raw | ConvertFrom-Json); return @($parsed | ForEach-Object { if($_ -is [string]){ $t=$_.ToString(); [pscustomobject]@{ title=$t; score=0; length=$t.Length } } elseif($null -ne $_.title){ [pscustomobject]@{ title=$_.title.ToString(); score=[int]$_.score; length=[int]$_.length } } else { $t=$_.ToString(); [pscustomobject]@{ title=$t; score=0; length=$t.Length } } }) } catch { $text=$raw.Trim(); if($text.StartsWith('[') -and $text.EndsWith(']')){ $inner=$text.Substring(1,$text.Length-2); if($inner.StartsWith('

')){ $inner=$inner.Substring(1,$inner.Length-2) }; if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($inner)){ return @() }; $parts=@($inner -split '","'); return @($parts | ForEach-Object { $t=$_.Trim(); [pscustomobject]@{ title=$t; score=0; length=$t.Length } }) }; return @() } }; $items=Parse-ScoredList $itemsRaw; $csv = $items | Select-Object title, score, length | ConvertTo-Csv -NoTypeInformation; ($csv -join [Environment]::NewLine)

tasks.name: 9 - Build Markdown Report
tasks.description: Creates a markdown report using scored data + API response + CSV excerpt.
tasks.commandLine: $title='${input:reportTitle}'; $query='${input:query}'; $runId='${input:runId}'; $scoredRaw='${input:scoredJson}'; $apiRaw='${input:apiSummaryJson}'; $csv='${input:csvText}'; function Parse-ScoredList([string]$raw){ if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($raw)){ return @() }; try { $parsed=@($raw | ConvertFrom-Json); return @($parsed | ForEach-Object { if($_ -is [string]){ $t=$_.ToString(); [pscustomobject]@{ title=$t; score=0; length=$t.Length } } elseif($null -ne $_.title){ [pscustomobject]@{ title=$_.title.ToString(); score=[int]$_.score; length=[int]$_.length } } else { $t=$_.ToString(); [pscustomobject]@{ title=$t; score=0; length=$t.Length } } }) } catch { $text=$raw.Trim(); if($text.StartsWith('[') -and $text.EndsWith(']')){ $inner=$text.Substring(1,$text.Length-2); if($inner.StartsWith('

')){ $inner=$inner.Substring(1,$inner.Length-2) }; if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($inner)){ return @() }; $parts=@($inner -split '","'); return @($parts | ForEach-Object { $t=$_.Trim(); [pscustomobject]@{ title=$t; score=0; length=$t.Length } }) }; return @() } }; function Parse-ApiSummary([string]$raw){ if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($raw)){ return [ordered]@{ endpoint=''; receivedBytes=0; responseKeys=@() } }; try { $obj=$raw | ConvertFrom-Json; return [ordered]@{ endpoint=($obj.endpoint); receivedBytes=([int]$obj.receivedBytes); responseKeys=@($obj.responseKeys) } } catch { return [ordered]@{ endpoint=''; receivedBytes=0; responseKeys=@() } } }; $scored=Parse-ScoredList $scoredRaw; $api=Parse-ApiSummary $apiRaw; $top=$scored | Select-Object -First 5; $lines=@(); $lines += '# ' + $title; $lines += ''; $lines += '- Run ID: ' + $runId; $lines += '- Query: ' + $query; $lines += '- Generated: ' + (Get-Date).ToString('u'); $lines += ''; $lines += '## Top Headlines'; foreach($item in $top){ $lines += ('- ({0}) {1}' -f $item.score, $item.title) }; $lines += ''; $lines += '## API Post Summary'; $lines += '- Endpoint: ' + $api.endpoint; $lines += '- Payload bytes: ' + $api.receivedBytes; $lines += '- Response keys: ' + ((@($api.responseKeys) -join ', ')); $lines += ''; $lines += '## CSV Snapshot'; $lines += '```csv'; $lines += $csv; $lines += '```'; $lines -join [Environment]::NewLine

tasks.name: 10 - Persist Report To Docs
tasks.description: Writes report markdown to docs folder and outputs final path.
tasks.commandLine: $runId='${input:runId}'; $report='${input:reportMarkdown}'; $safeRunId=($runId -replace '[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]','_'); $root=(Get-Location).Path; while($true){ if(Test-Path (Join-Path $root 'Tsky.sln')){ break }; $parent=Split-Path -Path $root -Parent; if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($parent) -or $parent -eq $root){ break }; $root=$parent }; $docsDir=Join-Path $root 'docs'; New-Item -Path $docsDir -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null; $path=Join-Path $docsDir ("pipeline-report-$safeRunId.md"); Set-Content -Path $path -Value $report -Encoding UTF8; Write-Output $path
